name: print-social-coworking-posts-cream-orange-with-flat-illustrations
title: Cream coworking pack with orange bars, squiggle lines and flat people illustrations
whatItIs: Nine cream square posts for a coworking brand: big orange headlines ('We Are Here To Help You'), a red squiggly line, flat illustrations of people on laptops, pricing boxes (Daily, Monthly, Annually), stacked orange/yellow/black bars and orange footer strips.
whatItMeans: Warm, casual and friendly; the scribble and flat figures make office space feel relaxed.
techniques: Draw one loose squiggle as a signature accent.
Use outlined boxes for plan options.
Pair flat figure illustrations with lots of cream space.
Finish every post with the same coloured footer strip.

vocabulary.definition: A coloured band along a post's bottom edge.
